title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30137: allow overriding cost share application
summary: An integration event was added to the Cost Shares Breakdown report to allow extensions to override how cost share application calculates and applies cost values to capacity and overhead amounts.
key_points: Integration event added to ApplyShareOfCostToCostShareBuffer procedure
Enables custom costing scenarios to replace standard share calculation logic
Extracted standard share application into isolated method for override capability
Event uses IsHandled pattern for extension control
quote: Custom costing scenarios need to control how Report 5848 applies an output entry's share of cost to capacity and overhead amounts.
